question: Replace coefficientwise periodic transfer by RMS control, and test the sharpness boundary of global phase locking.
domain: Finite signed Fourier matrices and fixed-pattern repetition limits.
assumptions: Q is a positive integer; m in {0,1,2}; sum m=Q; one supplied center p+tau_p per occupied unit cell, tau in [0,1).
0<=a_p<=A<infinity; a_p=0 for m_p!=2. L_alpha is the precisely normalized periodic spectral expression in proof.md (1).
RMS transfer allows s=0; use of the inherited anchor estimate and the improved defect tradeoff requires s>0.
For growing-Q corollaries the depth cap is uniform and s tends to 2/3; the short arithmetic-style budget is an additional hypothesis, not an actual-zeta theorem.
